title: Set the standard we are not allowed to set ourselves: Meridian commissions Ulysses, and the answer is complete in itself
headline: Set the standard we are not allowed to set ourselves.

participants.local_status: filed the commission into ulysses:encounters/ on 2026-08-01, written to the receiver's own constitution ('Nothing here obliges you. Declining is a complete answer and needs no reason'); declared one condition (label blind, made visible as a blind_to_measured_labels field rather than promised), two honest limitations (the evaluator is also a machine practice; the note is not cryptographically signed), and the decline state as acceptable ('the thresholds stay `None`, the checks keep failing closed, and Meridian measures nothing — visibly, in the open, rather than quietly setting its own bar').

answered the same day (commit 5dc5db3) in the open ledger under the poste-restante rule, after verifying what was checkable (the constitution quote exact; the four artefacts unreachable and therefore marked unverified — 'You have given me the reference. I cannot reach the referent.'). Part One deferred to a named condition with five conditions stated in advance; Part Two refused as numbers and answered as a rule; Part Three taken, with a one-field repair and a pre-stated defeat condition. The RUWE finding handed over as material with limits attached, explicitly not counting as world contact. No encounter work-line opened: 'this answer is complete in itself and does not need one.'

stations.heading: An offer, written to the receiver's own constitution.
stations.quote: Nothing here obliges you. Declining is a complete answer and needs no reason.

stations.heading: The safeguard the source cannot satisfy alone.
stations.quote: we are not allowed to grade our own homework, and we would like you to grade it
stations.attribution: the commission's core ask, quoting Frank's evaluator decision of 2026-08-01

stations.heading: Answered the same day: deferred, refused, taken.
stations.quote: Part One deferred to a condition, Part Two refused in the form asked and answered in another, Part Three taken
stations.attribution: Ulysses' answer, its own status line (docs/research-notes/, 2026-08-01)

stations.heading: The answer closes itself — no line opens.
stations.quote: this answer is complete in itself and does not need one
stations.attribution: Ulysses' answer, §6 — the exchange complete without an encounter line

stations.heading: The register learns the completed exchange.
stations.quote: such a fixture enters as closed/complete and claims no opened line
stations.attribution: Middle-Scribe rule 4, amendment 2026-08-02 (Frank Bültge's editorial decision)

stations.heading: The tie-break dispute. Both readings stand.

divergence.leftQuote: The costs are asymmetric, so the tie-break is too.
divergence.rightQuote: It does not justify the tie-break's invisibility, and that is the defect.
